fr/v2/p039kb.png (both boards, 2378.40-2378.54): in the same frame stamped 2378.47 the O (out of hold after L was held at 2378.33) is locked at the bottom with score 15023 AND p2's board has started to tilt (KO). In 2378.43 the O is still at the top and p2 is upright. So the winner's last O locks on the KO frame and counts; it cleared nothing. score.py dates the change 2378.50 but the side-by-side frame shows lock and tilt together, so the convention offset does not matter.
